title: Christmas at The Anchor is open, and we cannot wait
preheader: Christmas dinner, four festive nights out, and a village pub ready to make a fuss of you.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner at The Anchor: roast beef, a Yorkshire pudding, pigs in blankets, stuffing, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts

data.placeholder_caption: Christmas table laid up, warm low light
data.headline: Bring your favourite people, we will do the rest
body: Christmas dinner is on from 10 November to 20 December. Gather everyone round one table, let each of them pick their own courses, and leave the rest to us.
Crackers, candles, proper trimmings and a room full of people enjoying themselves. It is far and away our favourite time of year here.

data.heading: What comes with it
body: Go for two or three courses and every adult gets a glass of prosecco, swappable for orange juice. Dinner comes with pigs in blankets, stuffing, Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts.
list_items: Everyone picks their own courses, so every single person gets exactly what they fancy
Six guests or more, Tuesday to Saturday, plus Sunday afternoons
£10 per person deposit, and it comes straight off your bill

data.heading: Know who books your work Christmas do?
data.body: If it is you, or you know who it is, we would love to be in the running. We are a family-run pub, and hosting your team this December would genuinely make our year. It would mean the world to us.

data.label: Pass us on to whoever organises yours

data.heading: Four festive nights to look forward to
data.body: Every one of them is a lovely excuse to round people up, and booking is open on all four.

events.title: Tasting Night
events.detail: A premium tasting night with dinner provided, 7pm. The theme is still a surprise and we cannot wait to share it.

events.title: Tinsel & Trivia Quiz Night
events.detail: £3 cash entry, 7pm. Festive rounds, proper prizes, and dinner beforehand if you fancy it.

events.title: Sleigh My Name: Festive Music Bingo
events.detail: £5, 7pm. Two themed rounds with Nikki hosting, and it is always a brilliant night.

events.title: Christmas Jackpot Cash Bingo
events.detail: £10 cash books, 10 games, 7pm, with a rollover Snowball up for grabs.

data.body: We want this to be the best Christmas this village has had in years, and it is the people who walk through the door who make it one. Come and be part of it.

items.text: and proudly still a village pub

data.body: Book your Christmas dinner, get your work do in the diary, or pop in for a pint and tell us what you are planning. We would love to hear from you.

data.ps_body: Do pass the work party bit on to whoever organises yours. We would love the chance to look after them, and you would be doing us a real kindness.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, and we would love to see you again this Christmas.
